ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the lower left of the figure is an organic fragment, where an R group is connected to a methylene group, which is then connected to a carboxylic acid carbonyl carbon; this carbonyl carbon is connected to an oxygen by a double bond, and is connected to a hydroxyl oxygen bearing H by a single bond. Above in the figure is a phosphorus center, and phosphorus is connected to three bromine atoms. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Represent the R group with the wildcard *, then the organic carboxylic acid fragment is written as *CC(=O)O. The inorganic fragment composed of phosphorus and three bromine atoms is written as BrP(Br)Br. After ignoring the arrows, these two fragments are separate components, so they are connected with a dot.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image connectivity, not the arrow-pushing: the left organic fragment is R attached to CH2, then to a carbonyl carbon bearing =O and -OH, so encode R as '*' to get *CC(=O)O. The inorganic fragment is P bonded to three Br atoms, so encode it as BrP(Br)Br. Because these are separate components in the transition-state drawing when arrows are ignored, join the two SMILES components with '.', yielding *CC(=O)O.BrP(Br)Br.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左下方是一个有机片段，R 基团连接到一个亚甲基，再连接到羧酸羰基碳；该羰基碳与一个氧双键相连，并与一个带 H 的羟基氧单键相连。图中上方是一个磷中心，磷与三个溴原子相连。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：把 R 基团用通配符 * 表示，则有机羧酸片段写作 *CC(=O)O。磷与三个溴原子组成的无机片段写作 BrP(Br)Br。忽略箭头后，这两个片段是分离组分，因此用点号连接。
